topic.title: Three Generations, One Song
topic.claim: 'Ghar Kab Aaoge' from Border 2 is working because the film put Sonu Nigam, Arijit Singh and Diljit Dosanjh on one track, and that's not a nostalgia play, it's a demographic hedge.
topic.behaviour: The Border 2 soundtrack pairs three major vocalists spanning generations on one patriotic song, dominating trending playlists through October with reels and reaction videos comparing their parts.
topic.mechanism: Put one singer each from the parents' generation, the millennial charts and the current Gen Z rotation on the same track, and every age group hears someone that's 'theirs' and has a reason to share it.
topic.group: Music listeners across age groups who discover film music through reels now, not radio
real_details: 'Ghar Kab Aaoge' from Border 2 features Sonu Nigam, Arijit Singh and Diljit Dosanjh
it has been dominating trending playlists through October 2026 ahead of the film's release
topic.news_peg: Border 2 soundtrack trending through October 2026 ahead of the film's release
topic.why_now: Song is mid-virality right now, pre-release

score.why: Three named singers on one track reframed as a demographic hedge rather than nostalgia, her kind of brand-logic-applied-to-culture move.
